cues.text: A hundred and ninety cabinets, fifty-four to a drawer.
Three upstairs for the ordering... the stamps tell you the sequence, it's a sequence I did not choose and cannot defend.
Twelve are elsewhere. You'll find them. They're difficult and they know it.
You'll want to know how long it takes.
I don't know. I never started.
One more thing, and I'll be brief, because I'm not entirely in control of the timing.
That's mine. It's the only one I ever filled out.
You'll find two gaps in the last cabinet. Second-to-last slot is mine. I'd take it as a kindness.
There's something folded inside it. That one doesn't go in a slot.
I'd meant to send it. I never worked out how from in here.
You'll be going out eventually, I'd appreciate if you sent it...
